experiment: DCF-23 learned message passing on the factor graph
data: DCF-22 splits: DCF-16 train + DCF-22 train_large (3,600 records, four training families) for training; DCF-16 val for epoch selection; DCF-16 held-out (200, six of nine families unseen) scored once after weights are committed

variants.mp_bp: message passing with BP beliefs as variable features and output = BP parity logit + learned correction
variants.mp_pure: same architecture without any BP input (graph and factor tables only)

bp_note: fg.loopy_bp with a fixed cap, independent of the record budget; BP is the input and the baseline

gates.M1: mp_bp held-out posterior MSE against the verified reference is below BP's for at least 2 of 3 seeds
gates.M2: acting on the mp_bp posterior beats acting on BP's posterior in held-out expected utility (bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean paired difference > 0) for at least 2 of 3 seeds
gates.M3: mp_pure held-out posterior MSE is below the constant p = 0.5 predictor's for at least 2 of 3 seeds (DCF-22's token models failed this)

compute_note: model multiply-accumulates per prediction are reported next to BP's counted operations; different units, not charged by any gate
reward: +1 correct, -penalty wrong, 0 abstain; act at p >= penalty/(1+penalty) or <= 1/(1+penalty)
